name: YAPYAP
detailed_description:
A magic-themed co-op horror game where you and up to 3 friends are minions summoned by a wizard to break into their rival’s towers to cause mayhem. Try to fulfill your vandalism target with an assortment of spells while avoiding magical beasts and monsters that protect the tower.

Keep in mind you're not a powerful wizard — you're just a chaotic little guy with barely enough magic to annoy and confuse people. Use the various artifacts and wands you find to help you cause bigger messes all in an effort to make the tower’s archmage hate you.

VANDALIZE

Break a piano, hide their key, pee on their rug - do anything in your power to ruin the archmage’s day. Every inconvenience you create gives you more points towards your vandalism target for the night.

CAST AND COMBINE SPELLS

Find and use magic way beyond your understanding to push, pull, smash, float, teleport, clone, nauseate, scramble, grow legs, fishify and more. Combine spells together with your teammates to come up with your own unique brand of chaos.

USE YOUR VOICE

Use your voice to cast wizardly incantations - enunciation matters so you better keep your voice steady no matter how dire the circumstances.

ESCAPE THE TOWER

You are not alone in the tower - there are all sorts of creatures patrolling the halls. Some are created to protect their study. Others are horrifying results of their magical experiments. There are even creatures of darkness unbeknownst to the archmage themselves.

Stay quiet, cause distractions, hide and finally when all else fails - run.

short_description: Online co-op horror game where up to 4 wizard minions go into an archmage’s tower. Use an assortment of spells to vandalize, break and steal - but beware the horrifying magical creatures that roam the halls.
